lines.text: Welcome back. How's the shoulder since last time?
Since last time I can reach the top cupboard again, no bother.
The night pain since last time is still waking me, though I couldn't tell you how many nights.
Lift up sideways. That's nearly full height now, just the last bit catches.
Lie on the other side at night with a pillow under the sore arm, and we'll call this the last session if it keeps going this way.
Great, thanks for all your help.
